steps.name: Build with two animals
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Build with a visit date, add **African Lion** and **Grevy's Zebra**, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: Both animals are on the itinerary.

steps.name: Schedule African Lion
steps.do: In Day Planner, use **Schedule an item** to schedule **African Lion** at **11:00 AM** (keep a normal duration).
steps.expect: **African Lion** pill appears on the timeline at **11:00 AM**.

steps.name: Schedule overlapping Zebra
steps.do: Open **Schedule an item** again, select **Grevy's Zebra**, set the same overlapping start (**11:00 AM**), then click **Schedule**.
steps.expect: **Unable to Schedule** appears with **That time is not available. Select another start time and try again.** and **OK**. Zebra is not scheduled.

steps.name: Dismiss and keep Lion
steps.do: Click **OK**, then cancel out of **Schedule item** if it is still open.
steps.expect: **African Lion** remains scheduled; **Grevy's Zebra** stays unscheduled.

steps.name: Find a weekend with time conflicts
steps.do: Use **Edit Itinerary** / **Build Itinerary**. On **Set Visit Date**, try upcoming Saturdays/Sundays until Meet the Guardians and/or Wild Encounters list at least two offerings that share the same start time (talk+talk, talk+encounter, or encounter+encounter). Note the date and the two names.
steps.expect: A weekend visit date is set and two same-time offerings are identified.

steps.name: Finish with both conflicting offerings
steps.do: Add both same-time offerings (extra animals optional), then **Finish**.
steps.expect: **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:** appears, including **Schedule Conflicts** listing both activities.

steps.name: Proceed with no selection
steps.expect: **Proceed Without Selecting an Activity?** appears (confirm uses **Proceed Anyway**).

steps.name: Cancel proceed-without-selection
steps.do: Dismiss that confirmation without confirming (Cancel / close).
steps.expect: Still on **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:** / **Schedule Conflicts**.

steps.name: Select one activity
steps.do: Select only one of the two conflicting activities, then click **Proceed**.
steps.expect: Issues dialog closes and the itinerary saves with that resolution.

steps.name: Only selected activity scheduled
steps.expect: Timeline shows a pill for the activity you selected; the other conflicting offering is not scheduled.

steps.name: Stable after conflicts
steps.do: Reload the itinerary panel / refresh the page and reopen **Itinerary**.
steps.expect: Scheduled state matches the last successful conflict resolution.
